feed.title: causari — Survival Report
feed.subtitle: Weekly counts of surviving lines from AI-tagged commits in open-source repositories. No ranks, no verdicts. CC-BY-4.0.

entry.title: Survival Report #9 · 2026-11-09
entry.summary: 15,826,982 of 27,960,795 lines introduced by 57,538 AI-tagged commits in 55 open-source repositories are still at HEAD (56.6 %). 95 % interval over the sampled repositories: 43.6 % to 68.8 %. Counts, not grades. CC-BY-4.0. DOI 10.5281/zenodo.24091343.

Revision 2 (2026-09-24): All-Hands-AI/OpenHands and OpenHands/OpenHands are one repository, renamed on GitHub; revision 1 counted its audit twice (the two files under repos/ are byte-identical, SHA-256 1500353f…).
